what: The checkout of the newsroom the tests run against: its pages import the reader code from api.newsroom.sgit.ai, and the harness routes that host to this working tree. CI checks it out at .newsroom/. A commit, not a branch: site v0.13.0, the merge of dev (v0.12.50) into the move, on claude/confident-hopper-ot37nz until it is dev.
